description_text:
Lover pendant ready for 3D print and production.
WIKI :
Origins of symbolHeart-shaped peepal leaves were used in artistic depictions of the Indus Valley Civilisation: a heart pendant originated from there has been discovered and is now exhibited in Delhi national museum.[citation needed] In the 6th-5th century BC, the heart shape was used to represent the heart-shaped fruit of the plant Silphium,[1] a plant possibly used as a contraceptive.[2] Many species in the parsley family have estrogenic properties, and some, such as wild carrot, were used to induce abortion.[3] Silver coins from Cyrene of the 6–5th BC bear a similar design, sometimes accompanied by a silphium plant and is understood to represent its seed or fruit.[4]
Earliest use
The earliest known possible visual depiction of a heart symbol, as a lover hands his heart to the beloved lady, in a manuscript of the Roman de la poire, mid-13th century.The combination of the heart shape and its use within the heart metaphor developed at the end of the Middle Ages, although the shape has been used in many ancient epigraphy monuments and texts. With possible early examples or direct predecessors in the 13th to 14th century, the familiar symbol of the heart represented love developed in the 15th century, and became popular in Europe during the 16th.[5] Before the 14th century, the heart shape was not associated with the meaning of the heart metaphor. The geometric shape itself is found in much earlier sources, but in such instances does not depict a heart, but typically foliage: in examples from antiquity fig leaves, and in medieval iconography and heraldry typically the leaves of ivy and of the water-lily. One possible early use in the 11th century could be found in the manuscript, Al-Maqamat written by Al Hariri of Basra. The manuscript includes an illustration of a farewell greeting between two men while astride their camels, with the heart shape seen prominently over their heads.[6][not in citations given]
The first known depiction of a heart as a symbol of romantic love dates to the 1250s. It occurs in a miniature decorating a capital 'S' in a manuscript of the French Roman de la poire (National Library FR MS. 2086, plate 12). In the miniature a kneeling lover (or more precisely, an allegory of the lover's sweet gaze or douz regart) offers his heart to a damsel. The heart here resembles a pine cone (held upside down, the point facing upward), in accord with medieval anatomical descriptions. However, in this miniature what suggests a heart shape is only the result of a lover's finger superimposed on an object; the full shape outline of the object is partly hidden, and therefore unknown. Moreover, the French title of the manuscript that features the miniature translates into Novel Of The Pear in English. Thus the heart shaped object would be a pear; the conclusion that a pear represents a heart is dubious. Opinions therefore differ over this being the first depiction of a heart as symbol of romantic love.[7] Giotto in his 1305 painting in the Scrovegni Chapel (Padua) shows an allegory of charity (caritas) handing her heart to Jesus Christ. This heart is also depicted in the pine cone shape based on anatomical descriptions of the day (still held upside down). Giotto's painting exerted considerable influence on later painters, and the motive of Caritas offering a heart is shown by Taddeo Gaddi in Santa Croce, by Andrea Pisano on the bronze door of the south porch of the Baptisterium in Florence (c. 1337), by Ambrogio Lorenzetti in the Palazzo Publico in Siena (c. 1340) and by Andrea da Firenze in Santa Maria Novella in Florence (c. 1365). The convention of showing the heart point upward switches in the late 14th century and becomes rare in the first half of the 15th century.[7]
The scalloped shape of the now-familiar heart symbol, with a dent in its base, arises in the early 14th century, at first only lightly dented, as in the miniatures in Francesco Barberino's Documenti d'amore (before 1320). A slightly later example with a more pronounced dent is found in a manuscript from the Cistercian monastery in Brussels (MS 4459–70, fol 192v. Royal Library of Belgium). The convention of showing a dent at the base of the heart thus spread at about the same time as the convention of showing the heart with its point downward.[8] The modern indented red heart has been used on playing cards since the late 15th century.[9]
Various hypotheses attempted to connect the heart shape as it evolved in the Late Middle Ages with instances of the geometric shape in antiquity.[10] Such theories are modern, proposed from the 1960s onward, and they remain speculative, as no continuity between the supposed ancient predecessors and the late medieval tradition can be shown. Specific suggestions include: the shape of the seed of the silphium plant, used in ancient times as a(n) herbal contraceptive,[10][11] and stylized depictions of features of the human female body, such as the female's breasts, buttocks, pubic mound, or spread vulva.[12]

description_text:
-  General 
 This is a 3d model of a pomegranate. It was modeled and prepared for photorealistic renderings, close-ups, stills and animation. The pomegranate model is ready to be inserted in your scene out of the box. 

  -  Meshes 
 The granat model is presented as single mesh in 2 versions. Mesh is quad based. Base model polycount is 5084 without stamens and 25K with stamens. High detail model included in .max and .obj formats. High detail model has ~1.3mil. quads. 

  -  Materials 
 .max 2014 files come with corona(1.5) and vray(3.4) materials. Other versions have basic materials, so you will need to adjust them in connection with your particular software.

  - Textures
 5 maps are supplied with this model. 8192×8192 16bit PNGs and 2048×2048 JPGs. The maps include diffuse, AO, glossiness, normal, displacement. The pomegranate model is uvw unwrapped.

  -  Formats
 The original file was created in 3ds Max 2014 with Corona and Vray materials (1.5 and 3.4). You will receive a 3DS, OBJ, LWO, FBX, SKP, C4D, 3DM and MAX file(2014). If you need any other format please enquire via CGTrader.

  -  Information 
 All preview images were rendered with Corona. You will get only the pomegranate and not the scenes used for the preview renders. Please also take into consideration that the preview images are the result of the post-production and the look of granatapple 3d model in your scene may differ due to the specific settings of your own scene. Product is ready to render out-of-the-box. Please note that the lights, cameras, and any background not described above objects are not included in the product. The model is clean and alone in the provided files, centred at origin and has real-world scale.

description_text:
A realistic red apple is presented. His size is 13.7 x 13.7 x 14.5 cm. 
You can see the detail of the mesh with solid view and wireframe view provided. 
The texture of the apple and his stem is procedural, done with only nodes in shading editor. 

  - Three Noise textures with colorRamp are used to have a realistic color of the apple. 

  - An ambient occlusion is used for the color yellow-green at the top of the apple.

  - A bump node is also used to give the apple some displacement effect. 

Warning : the complete texture can only be seen in blender's cycles mode. Indeed, an ambient occlusion node is used for the texture yellow-green at the top of the apple, and this node is not supported in eevee.

description_text:
A jubilee tree created from scanned data.
The asset was created using scanned data, edited and optimized after four games, cinematic or visualizations. All textures are PBR ready.
It is a small deciduous tree or shrub reaching a height of 5–12 metres (16–39 ft), usually with thorny branches. The leaves are shiny-green, ovate-acute, 2–7 centimetres (0.79–2.76 in) long and 1–3 centimetres (0.39–1.18 in) wide, with three conspicuous veins at the base, and a finely toothed margin. The flowers are small, 5 mm (0.20 in) wide, with five inconspicuous yellowish-green petals. The fruit is an edible oval drupe 1.5–3 centimetres (0.59–1.18 in) deep; when immature it is smooth-green, with the consistency and taste of an apple with lower acidity, maturing brown to purplish-black, and eventually wrinkled, looking like a small date. There is a single hard kernel, similar to an olive pit, containing two seeds.

Thanks and enjoy it!
Usagipan 3D Studios

description_text:
A pineapple bun (Chinese: 菠蘿包; Sidney Lau: boh1loh4baau1) is a kind of sweet bun predominantly popular in Hong Kong[1] and also common in Chinatowns worldwide.[2] Despite the name, it does not traditionally contain pineapple; rather, the name refers to the look of the characteristic topping (which resembles the texture of a pineapple).
菠蘿包係香港最普遍嘅麵包之一，差唔多每一間香港嘅餅店（麵包店）都有賣菠蘿包，而唔少茶餐廳同冰室亦有供應。一般作為早餐或點心食用居多。菠蘿包售價亦相當平，一般約港幣3至7不等，深受香港人歡迎。而除咗喺香港外，喺南中國地區亦都好普遍。
菠蘿包由於熱量、脂肪同膽固醇含量較高，曾被香港專家定為「十大不良零食」。
source: Wikipedia

description_text:
4 types of pizzas in 1 pack, Got  pepperoni  ,  Marghrita ,  sausage  and supersupreme pizza. Introducing our exquisite Pizza Pack, a detailed 3D model featuring four mouthwatering pizza varieties that cater to every pizza lover's cravings. At the heart of this delightful collection is the classic Pepperoni pizza, showcasing a golden-brown crust topped with a generous layer of zesty tomato sauce and gooey mozzarella cheese, adorned with a perfect spread of spicy pepperoni slices that create an irresistible allure.
Next, we have the Sausage pizza, which combines savory Italian sausage with fresh herbs, creating a hearty and flavorful experience. Its inviting aroma is enhanced by a symphony of toppings, including bell peppers and onions, all resting atop that same perfectly baked crust and rich cheese layer.
The Margherita pizza brings a taste of Italy with its simplicity and elegance. This version features vibrant, fresh basil leaves resting on a bed of premium mozzarella, complemented by a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil and a hint of tangy tomato sauce. Each slice embodies a celebration of fresh ingredients and traditional flavors.
Finally, the Supersupreme pizza offers the ultimate indulgence, loaded with an array of toppings that include pepperoni, sausage, bell peppers, onions, mushrooms, and olives, all melting together harmoniously under a luscious blanket of cheese. This pizza is a feast for the senses, visually captivating with its colorful toppings and richly textured crust.
This Pizza Pack 3D model showcases each pizza in stunning detail, from the bubbling cheese to the savory toppings, making it perfect for culinary presentations, animated scenes, or simply to satisfy your creative cravings. Each slice tells a story of flavor and tradition, inviting you to explore the delicious world of pizza in all its forms.

description_text:
Product info:
Product contains three model versions of the carved halloween pumpkin. Product reccomended for Blender users due to the fact that native format is .blend with all of its superiority over other file formats :).
The models have been made using Blender 3.0.The mesh is subdividable and the creases for the sharp edges have been defined. Model is high-poly, most of the surface details are modelled, not defined by normal maps so the model is quite good for 3d printing. Polygon numbers are starting from 24k (subdivision 0)to 1500k (subdivision level 3). Materials are defined using procedurally generated textures, and they contain base color, roughness and bumpiness parameters defined by procedurally generated textures inside Blender file.If you want to have textures as a seperate image files you have to bake them by yourself (all settings for the procedurally generated textures are already set).
There are three different versions of the pumpkin included in the Blender file, the difference between them is basically carved face shape. There is also an option to pick one of the two versions of the lid, one with the spiral tendrill and one with the straight.

Discover cellular biology in a new dimension with our 3D printed model of a plant cell! This model is a highly detailed and realistic representation of a plant cell, displaying the various parts of the cell in a three-dimensional format.

This model is called San Pedro or Echinopsis Pachanoi cactus. I made this with 3D scanning or photogrammetry technique. This model has 5 different vols, which vol1 is high poly and vol5 is low poly. You can see the verts value of each model in the pictures and at the bottom of this description. Also, all 5 models have the same UV, and the textures are set for all of them. Max 2019 - FBX - OBJ
4k PBR textures (Bass color - Normal - AO - Curvature - Thickness - Roughness and Roughness lighter)
vol1 : 107000 verts
vol2: 43000 verts
vol3: 16600 verts
vol4: 5700 verts

description_text:
Navel oranges, also known as winter oranges, have a characteristic that can help you tell them apart from other oranges. It is the feature that gives navel oranges their name: the navel! The navel orange actually grows a second “twin” fruit opposite its stem. The second fruit remains underdeveloped, but from the outside, it resembles a human navel—hence the name. They’re seedless, peel easily, and are thought to be one of the world’s best-tasting oranges.
The appearance of a navel on the orange is the result of a mutation which created a conjoined twin — an aborted second orange which looks like a human navel. The navel orange is a mutation of regular sweet orange. The original mutated orange was discovered in a monastery orchard in Brazil in 1820 by a Presbyterian missionary. It intrigued him that not only did the orange have a belly button AND a baby orange inside — but it was very sweet, and had no seeds. He made a cutting, propagated some little trees, and sent them to the the United States. Because the original navel orange with that mutation is seedless, all of the navel oranges that we see and eat today are genetically identical to the original orange.
The Parent Navel Orange Tree is a tree grown by Eliza Tibbets in Riverside, California, in 1873. The Riverside County tree was designated a California Historic Landmark (No.20) on June 1, 1932, and can be seen to this day at the corner of Magnolia Street and Arlington Street, Riverside, California. (https://goo.gl/maps/AChYgo5x7kbdAwqFA)
That's right, your produce aisle is filled with clones, each with an undeveloped conjoined twin that is genetically idential to an orange from Bahia, Brazil that mutated in the 1820's to resemble a disgusting human belly button. Yum!
These oranges are marked half off for quick sale. I wonder why?

description_text:
New Plant High detail Acoelorrhaphe Wrightii Garden
Acoelorrhaphe is a genus of palms with single species Acoelorrhaphe wrightii, known as the Paurotis palm, Everglades palm or Madeira palm in English and cubas, tique, and papta in Spanish.
It is native to Central America, southeastern Mexico, the Caribbean, Colombia, the Bahamas, and extreme southern Florida where it grows in swamps and periodically flooded forests. It is a small to moderately tall palm that grows in clusters to 5–7 meters (16–23 ft), rarely 9 m (30 ft) tall, with slender stems less than 15 centimetres (5.9 in) diameter. The leaves are palmate (fan-shaped), with segments joined to each other for about half of their length, and are 1–2 m (3.3–6.6 ft) wide, light-green above, and silver underneath. The leaf petiole is 1–1.2 m (3.3–3.9 ft) long, and has orange, curved, sharp teeth along the edges. The flowers are minute, inconspicuous and greenish, with 6 stamens. The trunk is covered with fibrous matting. The fruit is pea-sized, starting orange and turning to black at maturity.

Saribus rotundifolius is a hermaphrodite fan palm. The palm is evergreen, erect, and only grows having a single trunk ('solitary'). It grows at a height ranging from 15 to 25 meters, exceptionally up to 45 meters tall,[2] and thickness of 15 to 25 cm diameter at height. Its trunk is smooth and straight with a shallow rings of leaf scars. The trunk is rather massive and tapering. It usually grows to 60 feet (18 m) tall, but may rarely reach 90 feet (27 m) tall. The young trees have a green crown. This species is seldom seen with a slight skirt of drooping, dead leaves. The sheaths are chestnut brown in colour.

title: HDR 360 Panorama - DTLA - 01 California Dept of Transportation Texture
description_text:
This is a 32-bit floating point 360 degree HDR panoramic lat long image of some Downtown Los Angeles iconic location in the morning.  Shot during early hours, about 11am on a cloudy morning which became a big blue sky with sun as the shoot went on.  This image can be used in any 3D package for Image Based Lighting IBL.  The full range of light in this scene is contained in the HDR image and will be strong enough to illuminate your 3D scene and cast decent shadows.  I shot this 7 level exposure wedge, with a range from 1/80000 to 1/8th sec in step size of 2 full EV’s.  That gives a range of over 10 EV’s of light in this one exterior pano.  To see a full rez version and fly around the scene close up please search Tojek_VFX on 360cities website.  Exact location of the shot is DTLA, CA, 90012, around google map latlong, 34.049066, -118.254789All example images are realtime path trace done quickly with Nvidia Omnisphere software.

Real-world accurate model. Correctly scale modeled to represent precisely like in the real world.
In this product, all objects are ERROR-FREE. All LEGAL Geometry. Subdivisions are not required for this product.

– Perfect for Architectural, Product visualization, Game Engine, and VR (Virtual Reality) 
– No Plugin Needed. Light setup not included 
– Real-world scaled model with Inches unit setup 
– Make scene optimized and extreme light. Reduce render time 
– Easy to use & tweak. Just drop the model into your scene and start rendering and visualizing

– Well organized Model Name, Material name, Layers, Reset X Formed. Materials, Textures, Objects are named in English

New Plant High detail Rhapis Excelsa
Rhapis excelsa, also known as broadleaf lady palm or bamboo palm, is a species of fan palm (Arecaceae subfamily Coryphoideae, tribe Trachycarpeae) in the genus Rhapis, probably native to southern China and Taiwan. It is not known in the wild; all known plants come from cultivated groups in China. They were first collected by the Japanese for Tokugawa shogunate palaces, then popularity spread to Europe, and later to America where its low light and humidity requirements make it a common feature in malls and offices. The genus name is Greek - rhapis, meaning needle; and the species name is Latin for tall, though R. excelsa is not the tallest in the genus.

MORE INFORMATION ABOUT 3D MODELS :
JAPANESE SUSHI IS A TRADITIONAL JAPANESE DISH OF PREPARED VINEGARED RICE (鮨飯, SUSHI-MESHI), USUALLY WITH SOME SUGAR AND SALT, ACCOMPANIED BY A VARIETY OF INGREDIENTS (ねた, NETA), SUCH AS SEAFOOD, OFTEN RAW, AND VEGETABLES. STYLES OF SUSHI AND ITS PRESENTATION VARY WIDELY, BUT THE ONE KEY INGREDIENT IS SUSHI RICE, ALSO REFERRED TO AS SHARI (しゃり), OR SUMESHI (酢飯).
SUSHI IS TRADITIONALLY MADE WITH MEDIUM-GRAIN WHITE RICE, THOUGH IT CAN BE PREPARED WITH BROWN RICE OR SHORT-GRAIN RICE. IT IS VERY OFTEN PREPARED WITH SEAFOOD, SUCH AS SQUID, EEL, YELLOWTAIL, SALMON, TUNA OR IMITATION CRAB MEAT. MANY TYPES OF SUSHI ARE VEGETARIAN. IT IS OFTEN SERVED WITH PICKLED GINGER (GARI), WASABI, AND SOY SAUCE. DAIKON RADISH OR PICKLED DAIKON (TAKUAN) ARE POPULAR GARNISHES FOR THE DISH.
SUSHI IS SOMETIMES CONFUSED WITH SASHIMI, A RELATED DISH IN JAPANESE CUISINE THAT CONSISTS OF THINLY SLICED RAW FISH OR OCCASIONALLY MEAT.

Modeled in Maya and textured with Substance Painter and Photoshop. The model is built to scale and is UV unwrapped with 4k textures. Includes 3D model and textures!

  - 2704 polygons

  - .fbx and .obj

  - Model has clean and neat topology and geometry

  - Built to scale (~15cm for large pot, ~10cm for small pot)

  - Model has neat UV map with optimized UV layout

  - 4k texture set for metal rough configuration

  - High quality texture details

  - 1 texture set for all 4 flowerpots

If you have any questions or concerns feel free to let me know :o

description_text:

I am at your disposal if you have any question.

description_text:
I made this for a friend who loves watermelons, and I hope it can be shared with other like minded fans. A small container in the form of a segment of water melon. Broken down into 4 colour prints, to be constructed with a glue. I have changed the design to include a wall cavity in the lid to reduce material and increase volume of space inside.
DESCRIPTION
I have printed these on a solid fill in and with 30 degree supports on an UP!Plus 2, which took the following times and used the stated amount of each filament:
BLACK 1.6 g Print time = 15 minutes
WHITE 11.3g Print time = 1 Hr 57 minutes
RED 10.4g Print Time = 2 Hrs 1 minute
GREEN 18.5 g Print time = 2 Hrs 48 minutes
This does require some clean up and glue for assembly. I used a liquid solvent cement to join the red, white and black pieces together. A nice finishing trick was to use some acetone to melt and mix the red filament with the white into a sludge that could be painted on blending the join.

description_text:
Grow your sprouted seeds easily at home and enjoy their benefits thanks to this sprouter adaptable to a classic jam jar!
Upcycle, Print, Sprout! Simple and playful.
Sprouted seeds have real nutritional advantages, especially vitamins and minerals. Pleasant to eat, they bring a fresh and crunchy touch to your salads, raw vegetables, fish...
Pour a tablespoon of seeds into your jar (Mason jar, Bonne Maman jam jar or other compatible jars).
Fill your jar with water, close it with your Sproot module and soak the seeds overnight.
The next morning, spill your jar over your sink to empty the water. Put your sprouter up to drain the seeds.
Twice a day, morning and evening, rinse your seeds with clear water. To do this, fill the jar with water under the tap of cold water, stir the jar well to untangle the seeds and then empty the water into your sink.
After rinsing, rest your sprouter upside down.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 for as many days as the germination time indicated on the seed packets.

There is in this scene one cube (size of 2cm, 0,787402 inches) that can be easily modify for more or less polygons. I have let the modifiers in the 3ds max scene. The model are ready to use. No plugins. You can just drop the item with the applied material in your scene but be carefull here, it's not the mesh which is important but the V-Ray shader. If you grow or shrink the mesh, the result will be change in the same scene like you can see in the image preview. The icecubes color will be change because of light and nearby objects in your scene. 
There is one shader and two seamless textures in Refract and Reflect Glossiness (2048x2048).
Made in its real side, metric in centimenters.  
----------------------------------------  
Software : 3Dsmax 2017.  
Renderer : VRay.  
----------------------------------------  
/!\ The scene contains only the object I sell here. Not the studio with vray light, environement and camera. 
/!\ Not the whiskey glass too. You can find it in my other models.

description_text:
Verifiably hip with the bold flowers coming out of the bright pink outlines.
This model is made up of two parts. The handle is solid while the bulb is hollow. The two pieces come together to create one whole maraca.
Because the bulb is hollow, things like beans, pebbles, or sand can be funneled inside before the handle area is sealed off. The connection was built so that the seal could more easily be hidden.
The maracas measure approximately 3 in x 3 in x 6 in when assembled. The two models can be scaled up pretty reliably.
Give it a nice paint job after and you'll be ready to show others what you got after landing on the island.

description_text:
Low poly Pokémon from Generation 3 are now available on our new Thangs account Polymon!
Pokémon cookie cutters
Cookie cutters of Pikachu, Eevee, Valor, Mystic and Instinct team Legendaries Moltres, Articuno, Zapdos, Pokeballs in different sizes (the biggest one being the size of an actual Pokeball) and then also the favoured food in the Pokemon world: rice wrapped in seaweed.
These models are cookie cutters to be 3D printed. The thickness of the wall is 1mm and the offset of the imprint is 3mm. You can scale it a bit down or up if you have a smaller nozzle or print them with one perimeter and also choose to stop the print sooner if you want to make very thin cookies with the imprint.
Files contain stl cookie cutters as shown on the pictures.
SCALEAt 100% scale the cookies are on average 65mm wide.You can scale the models as you like but have in mind that at 100% scale the walls are 1mm thin.
PRINTER SETTINGSWe recommend a layer height of 0.3 mm on FDM printers. All parts are aligned to the printing platform for easy manipulation. None of the parts need printing supports. Printing settings will vary greatly depending on your specific printer.
Do you like the model and don't have a 3D printer? There are lots of people who offer 3D printing services these days. Try searching for someone who offers them in your area.
This fan-made model was brought to life by 3Demon. We are a group of modeling and 3d printing enthusiasts based in Prague, Czech Republic.Here are some links to our website and social media where you can see more of our creations:
https://3d-mon.com/links/

If you have any questions, you can contact us trough support. Just send a support ticket!

description_text:
As I got a new table and love having friends over, I wanted to protect the table from damage as much as possible. I created these fun shaped coasters to keep the moisture from drinks away from the table surface.
There are a total of thirteen coasters that can be 3D printed from this set. The set is a combination of two different coaster designs I did.
One set features repeated geometric shapes (circular, wavy, triangular, square, hexagonal, pentagonal designs). The other set features doodles that I made and turned into coasters. These are harder to tell, but the names I gave them were Rose, Chicken Scratch, Crosshatch, Peony, Water Lily, Radio Wave, and Dust Ball.
Almost all of the coasters are between 3.5 to 4.5 inches across.
These models shouldn't require supports to print.​
Print these up in fun colors and enjoy a quick way of adding a little modern flair to your home.

description_text:
This is a vending machine found at Sinnae Station in the Northeast of Seoul. The vending machine has an image of drinks including two different quality levels of milk, sugar, and cream coffees, as well as milk and cocoa and also a drink called Job's Tears (adlay tea). “Storyway” is a convienence store brand meaning “various stories that you meet on the way.”
Job's tears, scientific name Coix lacryma-jobi, also known as adlay or adlay millet, is a tall grain-bearing perennial tropical plant of the family Poaceae (grass family). It is native to Southeast Asia, but introduced to Northern China and India in remote antiquity, and elsewhere cultivated in gardens as an annual. It has been naturalized in the southern United States and the New World tropics. In its native environment it is grown at higher elevation areas where rice and corn do not grow well. Job's tears are also commonly sold as Chinese pearl barley.
There are two main varieties of the species, one wild and one cultivated. The wild variety, Coix lacryma-jobi var. lacryma-jobi, has hard-shelled pseudocarps—very hard, pearly white, oval structures used as beads for making prayer beads or rosaries, necklaces, and other objects. The cultivated variety Coix lacryma-jobi var. ma-yuen is harvested as a cereal crop, has a soft shell, and used medicinally in parts of Asia.

Discover our cutters, we have a wide variety, with several sizes to choose from. They can be worn on casual occasions or even for professional use.
All cutters are made with a sharp, tapered tip, easily cutting through soft materials. On the other hand, they have an edge to make them firmer and less flexible.
The cutters can be used to make cookies, jewelry, small decorations, candies, etc.
Printing Tips:

  - Do not use nozzles larger than 0.4. Sometimes it is necessary to use 0.05mm horizontal compensation.

  - Smaller dimensions, easier to print in resin. But they work perfectly in FDM.

Usage Tips:

  - We recommend that the thickness of the dough is around 5 mm (~ 1/5 inch). Especially in dough cutters with details that only appear if the dough is more than 2mm.

  - For prettier cookies, follow a yeast-free recipe.

  - If you use flour and chilled dough you can get better results.

  - If it is to make jewelry, 2.5cm or 3cm is usually used. If your goal is to make cookies you should choose between 5-8cm. With small cutting edges it is more difficult to make details.

description_text:
An unusual vase is a good idea for a gift and decoration at home, and this is one of those things that prove that buying a 3D printer is a good idea.This sculptural vase in the shape of the fruit of an exotic plant looks good both in plain and in two-tone color. I liked the combination of platinum and yellow gold.A smooth surface with smooth bends is simply polished during post-processing and provides a beautiful game of highlights and shadows.A minimum wall thickness of 2.5 mm ensures waterproofness.
Project page: https://3dladnik.wixsite.com/workshop/sevenvases
The model is presented in two sizes:Vase7-220.STL 220 mm high,Vase7-275.STL 275 mm high.
If necessary, I can change the size of the vase and the wall thickness.
This vase is designed for trouble-free printing without supports with maximum productivity.
It was printed on a FDM printer Lad-1.0 (https://3dladnik.wixsite.com/portfolio/lad-1-0-en) with a nozzle of 0.5 mm, a layer height of 0.2 mm from ABS plastic.
Plastic Consumption:Vase 7, height 220 mm - 165 gramsVase 7, height 275 mm - 300 grams
Post-processing: grinding, chemical polishing with ethyl acetate.Coloring: acrylic enamels and polyurethane varnish. It was painted with a brush.
Note:This model is designed for printing in normal mode (NOT Vase mode).

description_text:
This is a 3d model of a Red Apple. Everything was done in Maya 2019.2, without any plugin. The texturing was done procedurally in Maya through the Hypershade and the model was rendered in Arnold 5.3.1.1. The Red Apple 3d model is a high-end, photorealistic model.
Features:

  - There is no post-production used on any of the renders you see. The last image of the preview images shows the model with three levels of subdivisions.

  - The lighting setup is included in the file.

description_text:
Design becomes eyes of love, ready for 3D print and produce.
WIKI :
Origins of symbolHeart-shaped peepal leaves were used in artistic depictions of the Indus Valley Civilisation: a heart pendant originated from there has been discovered and is now exhibited in Delhi national museum.[citation needed] In the 6th-5th century BC, the heart shape was used to represent the heart-shaped fruit of the plant Silphium,[1] a plant possibly used as a contraceptive.[2] Many species in the parsley family have estrogenic properties, and some, such as wild carrot, were used to induce abortion.[3] Silver coins from Cyrene of the 6–5th BC bear a similar design, sometimes accompanied by a silphium plant and is understood to represent its seed or fruit.[4]
Earliest use
The earliest known possible visual depiction of a heart symbol, as a lover hands his heart to the beloved lady, in a manuscript of the Roman de la poire, mid-13th century.The combination of the heart shape and its use within the heart metaphor developed at the end of the Middle Ages, although the shape has been used in many ancient epigraphy monuments and texts. With possible early examples or direct predecessors in the 13th to 14th century, the familiar symbol of the heart represented love developed in the 15th century, and became popular in Europe during the 16th.[5] Before the 14th century, the heart shape was not associated with the meaning of the heart metaphor. The geometric shape itself is found in much earlier sources, but in such instances does not depict a heart, but typically foliage: in examples from antiquity fig leaves, and in medieval iconography and heraldry typically the leaves of ivy and of the water-lily. One possible early use in the 11th century could be found in the manuscript, Al-Maqamat written by Al Hariri of Basra. The manuscript includes an illustration of a farewell greeting between two men while astride their camels, with the heart shape seen prominently over their heads.[6][not in citations given]
The first known depiction of a heart as a symbol of romantic love dates to the 1250s. It occurs in a miniature decorating a capital 'S' in a manuscript of the French Roman de la poire (National Library FR MS. 2086, plate 12). In the miniature a kneeling lover (or more precisely, an allegory of the lover's sweet gaze or douz regart) offers his heart to a damsel. The heart here resembles a pine cone (held upside down, the point facing upward), in accord with medieval anatomical descriptions. However, in this miniature what suggests a heart shape is only the result of a lover's finger superimposed on an object; the full shape outline of the object is partly hidden, and therefore unknown. Moreover, the French title of the manuscript that features the miniature translates into Novel Of The Pear in English. Thus the heart shaped object would be a pear; the conclusion that a pear represents a heart is dubious. Opinions therefore differ over this being the first depiction of a heart as symbol of romantic love.[7] Giotto in his 1305 painting in the Scrovegni Chapel (Padua) shows an allegory of charity (caritas) handing her heart to Jesus Christ. This heart is also depicted in the pine cone shape based on anatomical descriptions of the day (still held upside down). Giotto's painting exerted considerable influence on later painters, and the motive of Caritas offering a heart is shown by Taddeo Gaddi in Santa Croce, by Andrea Pisano on the bronze door of the south porch of the Baptisterium in Florence (c. 1337), by Ambrogio Lorenzetti in the Palazzo Publico in Siena (c. 1340) and by Andrea da Firenze in Santa Maria Novella in Florence (c. 1365). The convention of showing the heart point upward switches in the late 14th century and becomes rare in the first half of the 15th century.[7]
The scalloped shape of the now-familiar heart symbol, with a dent in its base, arises in the early 14th century, at first only lightly dented, as in the miniatures in Francesco Barberino's Documenti d'amore (before 1320). A slightly later example with a more pronounced dent is found in a manuscript from the Cistercian monastery in Brussels (MS 4459–70, fol 192v. Royal Library of Belgium). The convention of showing a dent at the base of the heart thus spread at about the same time as the convention of showing the heart with its point downward.[8] The modern indented red heart has been used on playing cards since the late 15th century.[9]
Various hypotheses attempted to connect the heart shape as it evolved in the Late Middle Ages with instances of the geometric shape in antiquity.[10] Such theories are modern, proposed from the 1960s onward, and they remain speculative, as no continuity between the supposed ancient predecessors and the late medieval tradition can be shown. Specific suggestions include: the shape of the seed of the silphium plant, used in ancient times as a(n) herbal contraceptive,[10][11] and stylized depictions of features of the human female body, such as the female's breasts, buttocks, pubic mound, or spread vulva.[12]

description_text:
Framboises candy high quality model. With a good amount of polygons to make it look soft. Ready to be subpatched, made from solid parts, after simple mesh automatic repair or boolean operations it can be 3D printed.

  - Watertight parts.

  - Quads and tris mix.

  - Model to scale, if your software changes the size while importing, use 20 mm or 0.78 inches tall.

  - The model is originally made in Modo, other software may require material edits.

  - Includes a high subdivision version for each format.

  - Open source compatible subdivision.

  - Formats included: .lwo, .obj, .fbx, .stl, .lxo (.obj contains UV information and is an industry standard that most software can use)

Included are textures. There is a color map, height/displacement map, specular/reflection color map, normal map, glossiness/ inverted roughness map, to make it compatible with different render engines.

  - Includes a .stl file for physical recreation, like 3d printing.

  - Different formats are available upon request.

  - The license may be limited to editorial depending on the specific local rule.

 .max 2014 files come with corona(1.5) and vray(3.4) materials. Other versions have basic materials, so you will need to adjust them in connection with your particular software.

Product is ready to render out-of-the-box. Please note that the lights, cameras, and any background not described above objects are not included in the product. Fraxinus /ˈfræksɪnəs/,[4] English name ash, is a genus of flowering plants in the olive and lilac family, Oleaceae. It contains 45–65 species of usually medium to large trees, mostly deciduous, though a number of subtropical species are evergreen. The genus is widespread across much of Europe, Asia, and North America.[3][5][6][7][8]
The leaves are opposite (rarely in whorls of three), and mostly pinnately compound, simple in a few species. The seeds, popularly known as keys or helicopter seeds, are a type of fruit known as a samara. Most Fraxinus species are dioecious, having male and female flowers on separate plants[9] but in ash is expressed as a continuum between male and female individuals, dominated by unisexual trees. With age, ash may change their function from predominantly male and hermaphrodite towards femaleness;[10] if grown as an ornamental and both sexes are present, ashes can cause a considerable litter problem with their seeds. Rowans or mountain ashes have leaves and buds superficially similar to those of true ashes, but belong to the unrelated genus Sorbus in the rose family.

description_text:
- General
This is a collection of blueberry models consisting of 6 different pieces. These were modelled and prepared for photo-realistic renderings, close-ups, CG visualization. The berries are ready to be inserted in your scene. There are 6 versions of berries included in this pack.
  - Meshes
The blueberries are presented here as a separate geometry(editable poly). The meshes of berries are all quads. The poly-count per berry varies from 10K to 23K polygons.
  - Vray Materials
As these models were primary created for vray render engine, the vray version of the file contains also properly configured and assigned materials for the berries. Other versions have basic materials, so you will need to adjust them in connection with your particular software and render engine.
  - Maps
These models of blueberries have each their own hand-painted 4K diffuse maps in PNG format. Beside that, they share a single 4K map for the bump slot.
  - Formats
The original file was created in 3ds Max 2012 with V-Ray materials (2.0 and above). You will also receive 3DS, STL, FBX, LWO, SKP, C4D(R11), OBJ and MAX file formats. 
  - Information
All preview images are rendered with V-Ray/Octane. You will get only the blueberries collection consisting of 6 different versions and not the scenes used for the preview renders. The materials of the berries are set up only for vray version. Please also take into consideration that the preview images are the result of the post-production and the look of the blueberry models in your scene may differ due to the specific settings of your own scene. Product is ready to render out-of-the-box. Please note that the lights, cameras, and any background not described above objects are not included in the product. The models are clean and alone in the provided files, centred at origin and have real-world scale.

description_text:
Todos mis diseños son creación propia respetando las reometrías de cada simbolo.
La estrella tetraédrica - MerKaBa
Esta forma surge del Fruto de la Vida de unir los centros o nodos de sus 6 círculos exteriores. La unión se realiza a través de líneas rectas formando 2 triángulos o tetraedros y sus vértices son los centros de 3 círculos cada uno, donde uno apunta hacia abajo y representa la energía femenina y el otro apunta hacia arriba y representa la energía masculina.
En geometría se les atribuye carácter o valor a distintas representaciones, las formas redondeadas simbolizan energías femeninas y las líneas rectas energías masculinas.
Esta figura se construye en base a estos 2 simbolismos, pero trasciende el valor del genero que habitualmente consideramos y lo que realmente expresa es la unión de los opuestos, la fusión de las polaridades Cielo-Tierra, Noche-Día, Blanco-Negro. Principios polares que están presentes desde el inicio de las figuras en todas sus expresiones y rotaciones pero que en este nivel son el emblema.

description_text:
Originally made in Substance Designer, this product does not include an sbs-file, only textures. There are 2 materials inside with 8 chains in each one, which gives you 16 chains. Ready for any game/render engine. Contains PBR and Non-PBR texture sets in 3 resolutions: 1024, 2048, and 4096. Also DirectX and OpenGL normals and so-called RMA texture which is Roughness, Metalic, AmbientOccusion textures in one RGB image. 
https://www.artstation.com/artwork/8ee2qE
PBR textures:

  -     BaseColor (1024x1024, 2048x2048, 4096x4096) x 2

  -     Metalness (1024x1024, 2048x2048, 4096x4096) x 2

  -     Roughness (1024x1024, 2048x2048, 4096x4096) x 2

  -     AO (1024x1024, 2048x2048, 4096x4096) x 2

Non-PBR textures:

  -     Diffuse (1024x1024, 2048x2048, 4096x4096) x 2

  -     Specular (1024x1024, 2048x2048, 4096x4096) x 2

  -     Glossines (1024x1024, 2048x2048, 4096x4096) x 2

Universal textures:

  -     DirectX Normal (1024x1024, 2048x2048, 4096x4096) x 2

  -     OpenGl Normal (1024x1024, 2048x2048, 4096x4096) x 2

  -     Height (1024x1024, 2048x2048, 4096x4096) x 2

  -     Opacity (1024x1024, 2048x2048, 4096x4096) x 2

  -     RMA (1024x1024, 2048x2048, 4096x4096) x 2

I've included a pillow mesh also, for anyone who's interested in what kind of UV I've used for renders

description_text:
-  General 
 This is a 3d model of a hazelnut.  It was modeled and prepared for photorealistic renderings, close-ups, stills and animation. The filbert model is ready to be inserted in your scene out of the box. 

  -  Meshes 
 The cobnut model is presented as single mesh in 2 versions. Mesh is quad based. Base model polycount is 806. High detail model included in .max and .obj formats. High detail model has 51k quads. 

  -  Materials 
 .max 2014 files come with corona(1.5) and vray(3.4) materials. Other versions have basic materials, so you will need to adjust them in connection with your particular software.

  - Textures
 5 maps are supplied with this model. 8192×8192 16bit PNGs and 2048×2048 JPGs. The maps include ao, diffuse, glossiness, normal, displacement. The hazel model is uvw unwrapped.

  -  Formats
 The original file was created in 3ds Max 2014 with Corona and Vray materials (1.5 and 3.4). You will receive a 3DS, OBJ, LWO, FBX, SKP, C4D, 3DM and MAX file(2014). If you need any other format please enquire via CGTrader.

  -  Information 
 All preview images were rendered with Corona. You will get only the filbert and not the scenes used for the preview renders. Please also take into consideration that the preview images are the result of the post-production and the look of hazelnut 3d model in your scene may differ due to the specific settings of your own scene. Product is ready to render out-of-the-box. Please note that the lights, cameras, and any background not described above objects are not included in the product. The model is clean and alone in the provided files, centred at origin and has real-world scale.

description_text:
HIGH POLY FOOD It is traditional turkey rice
DirectionsStep 1Combine leftover turkey leg, thigh, and meat in a stockpot over high heat; add chicken broth and onion. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium-low, and cover. Simmer, flipping turkey pieces over halfway, until meat falls off the bone, about 1 hour.
Step 2Transfer turkey pieces to a bowl and let cool until safe to handle.
Step 3Meanwhile, bring broth to a boil and stir in rice. Season with black pepper, cayenne, and salt. Reduce heat to medium and let rice simmer until it starts to plump up, about 10 minutes.
Step 4Pick turkey meat off the bone and chop into small pieces. Stir into the rice, adding more broth as needed. Cook over medium-low heat until rice reaches desired tenderness, 10 to 15 minutes.
Step 5Smash green onions, red pepper, and cilantro together for the salsa. Taste and season turkey rice as desired, then scoop into serving bowls and top with salsa.
Use any cooked turkey pieces you have. I ended up with about 14 ounces of picked meat.
Substitute broth with chicken stock or turkey broth/stock if desired.
I used medium-grain, but any rice will work.
Use any red pepper, sweet or hot, that you like.

Drywall (also called plasterboard, dry lining, wallboard, sheet rock, gib board, gypsum board, buster board, turtles board, slap board, custard board, and gypsum panel) is a panel made of calcium sulfate dihydrate (gypsum), with or without additives, typically extruded between thick sheets of facer and backer paper, used in the construction of interior walls and ceilings. The plaster is mixed with fiber (typically paper, glass wool, or a combination of these materials); plasticizer, foaming agent; and additives that can reduce mildew, flammability, and water absorption.

This polygon mesh representing a dolphin would be considered low poly by modern (2019) standardsLow poly is a polygon mesh in 3D computer graphics that has a relatively small number of polygons. Low poly meshes occur in real-time applications (e.g. games) as contrast with high poly meshes in animated movies and special effects of the same era. The term low poly is used in both a technical and a descriptive sense; the number of polygons in a mesh is an important factor to optimize for performance but can give an undesirable appearance to the resulting graphics.

The lopoly nature collection includes 46 lowpoly object of nature:35 trees(pine,oak,birch,acacia,spruces, etc.), 3 grasses, 3 mushrooms, 5 stones.

description_text:
The package contains 3 real-time photoscan-based models of chocolate rolls available in 2 levels of detail. Provided meshes have following resolution:

  - LOD 0: 1215 verts (2426 tris), LOD 1: 252 verts (500 tris)

  - LOD 0: 1226 verts (2446 tris), LOD 1: 251 verts (496 tris)

  - LOD 0: 1234 verts (2464 tris), LOD 1: 250 verts (496 tris)

Every mesh in the pack is closed and optimized for real-time rendering.Each model contains collision mesh and it is available in 4 file formats: blend, max, fbx and obj.Models are scaled according to metric system.
Every pastry is provided with 2 sets of 4K textures adjusted to 2 levels of detail.
Depending on dedicated usage, each set of textures is available in 3 versions containing following maps:

  - PBR Metallic/Roughness workflow: Base Color, Roughness, Normal (DirectX), Ambient Occlusion; totally 24 16 bit png files,

  - Unreal Engine 4: Base Color, Normal (DirectX), combined Ambient Occlusion (red channel), Roughness (green channel) and Metallic (blue channel); totally 18 8 bit png files,

  - Unity: Albedo, Normal (OpenGL), Ambient Occlusion, combined Metallic (RGB) and Smoothness (alpha channel); totally 24 tga files.

In order to use our models in preferred game engine please follow official guidelines of its provider.
HDR backgrounds not included.
All models in CHOCOLATE ROLLS PACK were created using photogrammetry and they are based on carefully picked real-life goods. While meshes were optimized to meet requirements of real-time rendering, high quality of photoscanned textures was enhanced by adding Normal maps, Ambient Occlusion and proper Roughness for various surfaces. Each model is provided with low (LOD 1) and mid-poly (LOD 0) version. First is dedicated for use as a gameplay item or level decoration and the later is suitable for closeups, ex. as a cinematic prop or an element of an architectural visualisation.
Note: ZIP file with meshes suffix in its name contain all available mesh formats.
